# R5.17 — Verify the early offline efficacy route (seq 186)

## Summary

Independent verification battery for the landed early offline efficacy
route (`finite_manifest_contrast` — R5.15 population → R5.16 estimator →
R5.16b routing, all consumed unchanged, zero source edits). Contributing
only: REQ-D-109 / REQ-D-310 / REQ-E-209 / REQ-H-010 — no second primary
owner; the full simulation battery and the method's numerical-validation
predicates stay owed to R5.40/GATE-G10 (GATE-G9 exclusion stands — no
study-level claim).

Implements `docs/tickets/186_R5.17__early-numeric.md`.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_17.rs` (600 lines — at the ≤600 trigger):
  a scenario harness (`Verdict` = Pass/Fail/ExpectedRefusal/
  UnexpectedRefusal/Unrun/UnknownError + `overall()` rollup that can
  never count unrun/discrepant/unknown/missing-metadata as a pass) +
  the EX-02 fixture + an independent numeric path (SplitMix64 +
  integer-Beta order-statistic sampler — different generator, sampler
  and quantile than the estimator's seeded inverse-CDF). Seven
  executed scenarios: exact-rational known answers, independent
  interval cross-check (tol 20_000 ppm @ 60,000 fresh draws), prior
  placement, unequal-n heterogeneity (equal-task 425_000 ≠ pooled),
  missingness refusals (unrun → UnresolvedCell, n=4 → ShortCell),
  persisted-report instrumentation (idempotent report_id, record.kind,
  full S.1 metadata, 8,000→64,000 doubling ladder, seed/tol/schema,
  integer-canonical ppm members). Four `*_cannot_pass` AC-2 proofs.
- `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` +DF-R5.17-1 (OPEN): recorded defect —
  `beta{2,2}` runs persist `predeclared_exploratory`/params 2,2 over
  Beta(1,1) math (`decl.prior` never enters the estimator's posterior
  mean/draws) — a mislabeled sensitivity arm caught by the independent
  review. Owed to R5.40/GATE-G10 with the proposed ~6-line seam.
- `docs/build/planning/2026-10-30_evidence-coverage.md` dated
  contributing note naming seq 186.
- `docs/build/runs/R5.17.md` run ledger (requirements, gap table,
  evidence log/report, finding).
